basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited for a temporary position of Senior Research Fellow under the Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar for an ISRO-sponsored project titled "RES-URSC-2022-024: Numerical simulation of III-V semiconductor thin films growth in MOCVD Process for Solar cell applications". The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹53,340/- including HRA, with an application deadline of 05/11/2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official recruitment portal.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/
Complete the online application form for the project staff position under Advertisement No. SPON/63043/Advt0350.
Submit all required details regarding educational qualifications, NET/GATE status, and research experience before the last date.
Ensure application submission is completed by 05/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: RES-URSC-2022-024: Numerical simulation of III-V semiconductor thin films growth in MOCVD Process for Solar cell applications
Rs.11,340/- per month (If applicable, as per Institute norms)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational qualification, national-level test requirements, and research experience stipulated by the funding agency norms. Essential Qualification: PG Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Material Engineering / Chemical Engineering or any Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE, (b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER etc. Required Experience: 02 years of research experience is required along with the above-mentioned qualifications. Academic Criteria: A minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Desirable Qualification/Experience: Prior experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics packages (e.g. Ansys Fluent), understanding of chemical reactions kinetics, and strong scientific writing and presentation skills. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹53,340/- per month including HRA. A house rent allowance of Rs.11,340/- per month is applicable as per Institute norms if applicable. The duration of the appointment is 12 months.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Development of a multi-scale modeling framework for III-V semiconductor thin-film growth in the MOCVD process for solar cell applications. Reactor-scale process modeling of the MOCVD process using a Computational Fluid Dynamics Framework like ANSYS Fluent. Working closely with the research team at SCL Mohali to validate the developed model.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used by the Institute. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process without assigning any reason.
